descent.name: The Descent (two levels: travel between them)
descent.text: A grey test installation: two levels joined by a lift and a stair, and two ways in.

warlord.name: The Warlord's Bunker (Levels 1 and 2)
warlord.text: A blast door in a hillside: the warlord's last army, sealed in. A new bunker in every world. Levels 1 and 2 so far, in borrowed furniture.
